build_wav2vec2_conformer_model: build a Wav2Vec2ConformerModel to extract audio features from raw speech waveform tensors
run_wav2vec2_conformer_for_pretraining: run Wav2Vec2ConformerForPreTraining with contrastive and diversity loss for self-supervised audio learning
run_wav2vec2_conformer_for_ctc: run Wav2Vec2ConformerForCTC with CTC loss for automatic speech recognition with a language modeling head
run_wav2vec2_conformer_for_sequence_clas: run Wav2Vec2ConformerForSequenceClassification to classify audio inputs into discrete label categories
run_wav2vec2_conformer_for_xvector: run Wav2Vec2ConformerForXVector with TDNN layers and AMSoftmax loss for speaker verification
